recipes.name: Ultimate French Toast | With Babish
ingredients: For the Preserved Lemon Blueberry Compote
For the Red Miso Maple Syrup
1 1/2 cups heavy cream (or 3 cups half and half)
instructions: For the Pain de Mie
For the Day 1
For the Poolish

In a medium mixing bowl, combine flour, milk, and yeast until fully hydrated. Cover and ferment at room temperature for 12-24 hours until bubbly and fragrant. - 150 g (00) flour - 150 g milk - ¼ tsp instant yeast
For the Dough
For the Day 2

In the bowl of a stand mixer, combine Poolish, milk, flour, sugar, salt, yeast, and malt powder. Mix until a shaggy dough forms. - 289 g whole milk - 525 g bread flour - 27 g granulated sugar - 13 ½ g kosher salt - 3 ⅓ g instant yeast - 1 ⅔ g diastatic malt powder - For the Poolish
Add butter gradually, mixing until fully incorporated before each addition. - 40 g unsalted butter room temperature
Knead 10-12 minutes total until smooth, elastic, and well-developed. - For the Dough
For the Cold Ferment
Shape into a tight ball, place in an oiled bowl, cover, and refrigerate for 16 hours. - For the Dough
For the Day 3
For the Second Ferment
Generously butter the Pullman pan.
Shape cold fermented dough into a tight log and place seam-side down in a buttered Pullman pan. Cover with plastic wrap AND the lid, then refrigerate for another 12 hours. - For the Dough
Let rise at room temperature 60-90 minutes or until 80-85% of the pan height. - For the Dough
Meanwhile, preheat the oven to 450° F.
For the Baking
Bake at 450° F with the lid on for 10 minutes. - For the Dough
Then, reduce the heat to 400° F and bake for 25 minutes.
Remove the lid and finish baking for 10-15 minutes more. - For the Pain de Mie
Allow to cool for at least 4 hours before slicing. - For the Pain de Mie
For the Toppings
For the Preserved Lemon Blueberry Compote
Combine blueberries, sugar, preserved lemon, and salt in a saucepan. - 2 cups blueberries - 1 cup granulated sugar - ¼ preserved lemon finely chopped - of salt
Bring to a simmer and cook 5-10 minutes until berries break down - For the Preserved Lemon Blueberry Compote
Taste and adjust with lemon juice and vanilla. - fresh lemon juice to taste - splash of vanilla extract optional
Cool slightly before serving. - For the Preserved Lemon Blueberry Compote
For the Red Miso Maple Syrup
Combine all ingredients in a saucepan. - 1 cup real maple syrup - 1 tbsp red miso - splash of mirin - splash of spiced rum optional
Heat gently to a bare simmer, whisking constantly until smooth.
Remove from heat and keep warm until ready to serve.
For the Crème Fraîche Chantilly

Combine all ingredients in the bowl of a stand mixer using the whisk attachment or using a hand mixer. - 1 cup heavy cream - ¼ cup Crème fraîche - 1 tbsp sugar - 1 tsp kosher salt - ½ tsp vanilla extract
Whip to stiff peaks. - For the Crème Fraîche Chantilly
Refrigerate until ready to serve. - For the Crème Fraîche Chantilly
For the French Toast Custard

Add all ingredients to a blender. - 6 large egg yolks - 1 ½ cups whole milk - 1 ½ cups heavy cream (or 3 cups half and half) - 1 orange zest - 2 tbsp granulated sugar - 1 tsp vanilla extract - ½ tsp nutmeg - ½ tsp cardamom - ½ tsp cinnamon
Blend until completely smooth and evenly spiced.
For the Toast Assembly
Slice cooled loaf into 1 ½ inch thick slices. - For the Pain de Mie
Leave the slices uncovered overnight or bake at 200° F for 1 hour until dry on the outside but soft on the inside. - For the Pain de Mie
Arrange the bread slices in a high-walled rimmed baking sheet. - For the Pain de Mie
Pour custard evenly over slices. - For the Pain de Mie - For the French Toast Custard
Flip halfway through soaking.
Soak 30-45 minutes, depending on dryness and preference.
For the Classic French Toast
Heat butter in a skillet or griddle over medium heat. - ½ cup unsalted butter
Fry soaked slices until deeply golden on both sides.
Serve immediately with Blueberry Compote, Crème Fraîche chantilly, Red Miso Maple Syrup, and powdered sugar. - Blueberry compote - creme fraiche chantilly - red miso maple syrup - powdered sugar
For the Brûléed French Toast
Preheat oven to 375° F
Melt butter and brown sugar together until smooth. - 1 cup dark brown sugar
Spread evenly on a nonstick rimmed baking sheet.
Arrange soaked bread slices directly on the sugar layer.
Bake at 375 °F for 25 minutes.
Flip slices brulee-side up onto a rack or a clean sheet.
Bake for another 10-15 minutes (or broil briefly) until sugar is glassy and crisp.
Serve topped with Blueberry Compote, Crème Fraîche Chantilly, Red Miso Maple Syrup, and powdered sugar. - Blueberry compote - creme fraiche chantilly - red miso maple syrup - powdered sugar
